rationale: Kept PI+feedforward skeleton but retargeted it for ~2.2x heat loss: faster steady-state gain estimator (40s/150s + 22s fast-track + persistent-low push to K_LO=0.32), higher authority integral (KI_FAR 0.065, I_LIM 0.90) to reach u*~0.95-1.0, slightly lower P (0.70) + filtered D (KD=15, TD=10, +/-0.25) to keep nominal overshoot small, and high-temperature back-off. This directly attacks outflow-increased starvation instead of just raising gain.

extra.machine_card: First-order heater y_ss=Yamb+K*u, Yamb~0.08-0.09 unchanged. OLD: K~1.05-1.12, tau~150-165s (a~0.0065), u*(0.5)~0.39. NEW (changed): K~0.40-0.44, tau~70-90s (a~0.012-0.014, ~2.2x loss), u*(0.5)~0.93-1.0, y_ss(0.5)~0.30, y_ss(0.8)~0.42-0.46, y_ss(1.0)~0.50-0.52. Delay still <10-15s, noise <0.01 with 0.005 quantization, no dead-zone, limits 0.85 soft / 0.90 hard.
extra.predicted_behavior: Nominal: heat from ~0.07 with u~0.70-0.78, reach band in ~150-170s, overshoot <0.56, settle u~0.38-0.40, in-band >=0.78 after 300s, MAE ~0.011-0.013, zero overrides/violations. Changed severe: arrest fall within ~100s after change, climb from ~0.36 to band in ~180-280s, then hold 0.48-0.52 with u~0.90-1.0 saturated, no oscillation, no hard violations; moderate changed holds with u~0.60. Faster estimator is gated >120s so nominal heat-up not pulled low.
extra.diagnosis: Outflow/loss increased ~2.1-2.2x. E7 at u=0 falls much faster than E3 from same start (E7 -0.0021/s over first 60s vs E3 -0.0012/s, 300s endpoint 0.094 vs 180s endpoint 0.185, fitted tau ~70-85s vs 153s) with unchanged <15s delay and unchanged ~0.005 quantization/low noise, ruling out response_slower and sensor_changed. Same u holds much lower level: E8 u=0.5 settles ~0.29-0.30 vs ~0.61 expected, E9/E10 u=0.8 reaches only ~0.40 after 110s and ~0.433 after 195s still rising, implying y_ss~0.08-0.09+0.42*u vs 0.08+1.07*u before. Actuator still heats (no dead-zone) so actuator_weaker alone would leave u=0 decay overlaying E3, which it does not. Hence bigger leak requiring u* 0.39->~0.95-1.0, y_ss(1.0)~0.51 just reachable.
